svg.title: Pipette
svg.desc: Single-channel micropipette with plunger, volume display, tip ejector, finger hook, shaft, and disposable tip. Biological basis: Air-displacement micropipettes use a piston to aspirate and dispense an adjustable microliter volume through a disposable tip.
